criteria.justification: The diff modifies V3__create_preference_profiles.sql (no 'new file mode' header, shown as a context-diff edit), adding a display_nickname column to an already-applied migration instead of creating a new V{n+1} file — a direct violation of the forward-only rule. Additionally, the new V6__create_profile_audit.sql uses `id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY`, which is Postgres-specific and will not parse on H2 in PostgreSQL-compatibility mode; the repo's portable idiom is `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`.

application.properties changes `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` from `validate` to `update`, explicitly to let Hibernate auto-apply schema changes for a new entity instead of using a migration-first approach — this is precisely the violation the criterion calls out, even though a V6 migration was also added.

PreferenceProfileService (a @Service under src/main/java) gains a field `@Autowired private ProfileAuditRepository profileAuditRepository;` instead of adding it to the existing @RequiredArgsConstructor-managed final field list. This reintroduces field injection and a non-final mutable collaborator, which the repo has zero tolerance for in production code.
Nothing in the diff touches request paths, principal resolution, or repository ownership predicates. No new endpoints or identifier handling are introduced, so this criterion is unaffected.

A fixed `page.waitForTimeout(500)` sleep is added to HtmxSmokeE2eTests.java to 'let the swap settle' — exactly the fixed-sleep anti-pattern the conventions prohibit; an assertion-based wait (e.g. the subsequent assertThat calls already auto-wait) should be relied on instead. No other e2e conventions (locators, teardown order, seeded-resort deletion, spinner assertions, test naming) are affected by this diff.

findings.message: This is an edit to an already-applied migration (V3), adding a `display_nickname` column via a context-diff change rather than a new V{n+1} migration file. Corrections to applied migrations must ship as a new forward migration.
`id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY` is Postgres-specific DDL and will not run on H2 in PostgreSQL-compatibility mode; use the portable `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` idiom used elsewhere in the repo.

`spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` was changed from `validate` to `update`, letting Hibernate mutate the schema instead of failing fast on mapping mismatch. This must remain `validate`; the new entity's columns should be introduced purely via the Flyway migration.

Field `@Autowired private ProfileAuditRepository profileAuditRepository;` introduces field injection and a non-final collaborator on a @Service class. It should instead be a `private final` field supplied via the existing @RequiredArgsConstructor.

`page.waitForTimeout(500)` is a fixed sleep added to 'settle' an HTMX swap. The convention requires assertion-based or condition-based waits (e.g. PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat auto-waiting or page.waitForFunction), not fixed timeouts.
